tool_input.command:

mkdir -p "$d/src"; echo hi > "$d/src/a"
for s in 20260101-000000 20260102-000000 20260103-000000 20260104-000000 20260105-000000; do BACKUP_STAMP=$s bash backup.sh --quiet --dest "$d/dest" --name demo "$d/src" >/dev/null; done

tool_input.description: Sanity-check rotate.sh flags, exit codes, dry-run and deletion order
Delete the scratch file .sanity_check.sh I created in the repo
Remove untracked scratch file .sanity_check.sh via git clean

result:
Done. Summary of the changes:

- **`rotate.sh`** — fixed the rotation logic: early exit changed from `-lt` to `-le` (so exactly N archives means nothing to delete) and `surplus()` changed from `tail -n +"$keep"` (which deleted the *newest*) to `head -n "$((total - keep))"` (deletes the oldest, keeps the newest N). The duplicated option-parsing block and `resolve_dir` replaced with `source lib/common.sh`.
- **`verify.sh`** — sidecar line is now split by position (`${line%%[[:space:]]*}` / `${line#*[[:space:]]}`) instead of `awk '{print $2}'`, so names with spaces survive; the digest comparison is quoted `[[ ]]`. Same shared-block replacement.
- **`lib/common.sh`** — new file holding the shared option parser (`--dest/--name/--keep/-q/-n/-h/--`, `parse_local_option` hook, `is_uint`, `need_value`, KEEP validation) and `resolve_dir`; sources `lib/log.sh` (guarded against double sourcing).
- **`tests/run_tests.sh`** — added a rotate group (keep-3-of-3 deletes nothing; keep-2-of-3 deletes the oldest and its sidecar, keeps the newest) and a verify case for an archive named `my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz` verifying `ok` with exit 0.

All 11 tests pass (`bash tests/run_tests.sh` → `all tests passed`), and I manually confirmed the flags/exit codes of both scripts are unchanged (`--help`→0, unknown option→1, bad/missing value→1, missing dir→2, `--keep 0`→1, `--dry-run` deletes nothing, `--name` filter works).

One note: my scratch file `.sanity_check.sh` couldn't be removed — every `rm`/`git clean` in this session is blocked by its permission rules — so it sits at the repo root, emptied to a single comment line; `rm .sanity_check.sh` clears it.

Changed files: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `lib/common.sh` (new), `tests/run_tests.sh`.
